title: Big Little Lies
author: Liane Moriarty
summary: Three mothers at a seaside Australian school become tangled in playground feuds, secrets and a rumour that spirals. The story is told through gossip and witness interviews that lead up to a death at a school party.
readIf: you like sharp, funny suburban drama with a serious undercurrent and a mystery to keep you reading.
skipIf: you want to avoid domestic violence and sexual assault, which are central to the later part.

pairings.reason: Another novel about mothers, secrets and the cracks beneath a polished, comfortable suburb.
A more straightforward and chilling suburban thriller built on a disappearance and what neighbours hide.
